title: THE FORGE: ACID ROUNDS EAT ARMOUR
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns and add elemental damage. ACID is the fourth element. An acid round eats into a pillager armour plate before the plate soaks it, and for 4 seconds after that the plate stops only half of what it would, for every round that hits him, a teammate round too. A Breacher Plate is gone in about seven upgraded rifle hits instead of about twenty. Machines take a quarter more damage from acid rounds. No gun can be upgraded in play yet: the Forge station comes in a later build.
now: Acid rounds from a MK III gun eat armour plates and hurt machines more.
